decisions.reason: Collecting and routing TicketsAwarded logs may support ticket accounting implementation, but it does not change the required ticket counts, recipients, surfaces, or consistency rules.
Ingesting Mint and other contract logs does not change when success feedback appears, which token ID it displays, or the required referral-specific message variants.
The webhook configuration does not revise any FAQ copy or the product behavior described by that copy.
Collection of TicketsAwarded and related logs does not alter the no-referral allocation trigger, random recipient rule, ticket count, or first-mint exception.
The source changes contract-log ingestion coverage, not the metadata attributes, their visibility, or the required accuracy of reward-accounting attributes.
Routing ReferralUsed and other logs does not change the amount, allocation condition, random-recipient policy, or finalization semantics of no-referral commissions.
The backend webhook setup does not entail any change to About-page text, process descriptions, technology items, or feature copy.
Ingesting contract logs does not modify the trigger, recipient, quantity, lifecycle, or secondary-sale exclusion for code-used prize tickets.
The event-ingestion mechanism does not change the code-used commission amount, trigger, recipient, payout destination, timing, or earning limits.
Contract-log collection has no necessary effect on which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or prize-ticket state transfer during resale.
Broader log ingestion may support commission projections operationally, but it does not change the required commission count basis or display-consistency rules.
The webhook configuration does not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or prize-pool revenue allocation.
